title: TruthInsightBench: An Evidence-Grounded Benchmark for Automated Evaluation of Open-Ended Scientific Discovery Agents
reasons: 新基准贡献、评分协议和资源证据达到配置的送审门槛；链接内容仍需人工核查
missingSignals: 报告基线或多个模型的评测

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We present TruthInsightBench, a benchmark configured for discovery.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Existing benchmarks are configured for reproduction: tasks, data, and rubrics are built around a hidden target study, and recovery of its result is rewarded.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: TruthInsightBench makes this gap a measurable target; data and scoring code are at https://github.com/TruthInsight-stack/TruthInsightBench.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Its 40 blind tasks, drawn from 40 peer-reviewed studies across 10 scientific domains, expose only a neutral scientific objective and frozen data; source conclusions, expected values, and analysis paths are withheld, leaving the agent to determine what claim the data support.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: On one frozen base model, four coding agents form a narrow plateau (58.4-60.3 of 100) with no statistically reliable pairwise separation: they execute and document analyses competently, with comparatively strong evidence auditability and novelty, but largely lack the discriminating acts that establish a trustworthy claim (controls, robustness, falsifiability, and cross-dataset generalization).

evidence.label: 材料中提供代码或数据链接（未核验内容）
